description: Welcome to Chorus Music v1.1.1! This update focuses on delivering a robust offline experience.

changelog.title: Features & Improvements
items: Offline Mode: A beautiful offline card now appears on the Home screen when disconnected, providing quick access to Local Music, Downloads, and Offline Playlists
Auto-Updater Prompt: The app now proactively prompts you on startup when a new update is available

changelog.title: Bug Fixes
items: Offline Album Art: Fixed an issue where local album artwork was missing in the mini player and notification while offline
Updater: Fixed an issue where the update dialog showed 'null' instead of the release notes
Security: Fixed an implicit PendingIntent vulnerability in the updater
Offline Playback: Fixed an issue where offline songs were not being added to the play queue correctly
